subject: Request: exportable operation trace package for compliance review
messages:
From: Samir Rao <samir.rao@novahealth.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@novahealth.com
Date: Tue, 20 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: exportable operation trace package for compliance review

Hi Tessa,

We're running a compliance pass for NovaHealth ahead of an upcoming SIG/SOC2 submission and need a package of operation traces and admin activity that our auditors can verify. High level asks:

- What categories of admin/operator activity do you log (user actions, role changes, API keys created/rotated, session/IP, console logins, deployment/rollouts)?
- What fields are included by default (timestamps, actor id, actor email, org id, action type, resource id, request IP, user agent, request payload hash)?
- What are typical retention windows for hosted vs dedicated vs private deployments?
- Can you provide export in machine-readable format (JSONL or CSV) and a sample manifest describing the bundle?
- Do you support pushing an encrypted bundle to customer S3 (customer-managed bucket) or do you provide a presigned URL? Any chain-of-custody notes?

If you can provide a short sample (one day of admin events) and the manifest that maps fields to controls, that would help accelerate our security review. Procurement has asked me to get any related links (DPA amendment, export SLA) up front.

Thanks,
Samir Rao
Security & Compliance, NovaHealth
procurement@novahealth.com

From: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.ai>
To: Samir Rao <samir.rao@novahealth.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 20 Apr 2027 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: exportable operation trace package for compliance review

Hi Samir — thanks for the clear list. Quick summary + what I can attach now: redwood_admin_activity_schema.csv (schema + field descriptions) and export_sample_manifest.jsonl (example manifest).

Short answers:
- Categories logged: admin_console_login, api_key_create, api_key_rotate, role_update, permission_change, model_deploy, model_rollback, config_change, datasource_connectivity, audit_config_changes. We also emit operator-initiated service restarts and scheduled job triggers.
- Default fields: event_id, timestamp_utc, actor_id, actor_email (for managed accounts), org_id, action, resource_type, resource_id, ip_address, user_agent, request_id, request_payload_hash, result_status, aws_region (if applicable), host_instance_id. Sensitive request payloads are hashed/omitted per PII policy.
- Retention: Hosted defaults to 90 days for detailed admin events (longer aggregates retained per policy). Dedicated customers can opt for 365-day retention on request (contract amendment). Private deployments are customer-controlled. We can export historical 13-month snapshots on a case-by-case basis (export SLA applies).
- Export formats: JSONL (preferred), CSV for columns-only exports. Each bundle includes a manifest mapping file -> field schema + export checksum.
- Transfer options: presigned S3 upload (recommended), S3 push to customer-managed bucket (we request a write-only role scoped to path), or encrypted HTTPS transfer. Chain-of-custody: we stamp bundles with generation timestamp, MD5/SHA256 checksums, and a signed manifest.

Next steps I'd propose:
1) I attach the schema and a sample manifest now.
2) Confirm the time window you want in the sample (e.g., last 24 hours vs specific date range).
3) If you want a historical 13-month pull, we'll open an export job (ETA ~72 hours) and provide a presigned URL that expires in 7 days.

Annexed attachments: redwood_admin_activity_schema.csv, export_sample_manifest.jsonl

Regards,
Tessa Morgan
Enterprise Security Liaison | Redwood Inference

From: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.ai>
To: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 21 Apr 2027 08:22:00 -0700
Subject: FW: Request: exportable operation trace package for compliance review

FW: NovaHealth request (see below). Monica/Karthik — quick internal runbook I want to follow for this delivery: 

- Deliverable A: 90-day sample bundle (JSONL), includes admin_console_login, api_key_create/rotate, role_update events. Bucket: customer-managed S3 preferred. Provide presigned link if they cannot grant write role.
- Deliverable B: Optional 13-month historical snapshot (requires export job and engineering approval, ETA 72 hours).
- Integrity: attach manifest with SHA256 checksums + generation stamp. Keep chain-of-custody log (who pulled, who uploaded, presigned link issued to which email).
- Security: enforce server-side encryption (SSE-S3 or SSE-KMS) depending on customer's preference. If customer requests KMS, route request to SecurityOps for key policy review.
- Legal: procurement asked for DPA amendment + export SLA link — send DocuSign placeholder and HubSpot ticket.

Can you own the export job (Monica) and confirm the S3 path & presigned TTL? Karthik — I'll need a standard note about pricing/credits for historical pulls if procurement asks (we generally bill for heavy export jobs under the Dedicated export line item).

I'll draft the external reply once we confirm.

- Tessa

From: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.ai>
To: Samir Rao <samir.rao@novahealth.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, procurement@novahealth.com
Date: Fri, 23 Apr 2027 10:15:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: exportable operation trace package for compliance review

Hi Samir — quick update and delivery of the sample bundle.

What we delivered today (attached / links below):
- sample bundle: one-day slice of admin events (90-day retention class) exported as JSONL. File: sample_admin_events_20270422.jsonl
- manifest: export_sample_manifest.jsonl (maps fields, includes SHA256 checksums)
- schema: redwood_admin_activity_schema.csv (field descriptions + control mappings)

Delivery options we implemented:
- presigned S3 link (one-time download) — I placed the link in s3_presigned_link.txt inside this thread. The link expires in 7 days.
- If you prefer a push into your bucket, provide a write-only role and path (we limit scope to /exports/novahealth/).

Historical snapshot: we can start a 13-month historical export if you confirm scope. ETA ~72 hours from job open; export will be staged in an encrypted customer S3 folder and we will provide a signed manifest + chain-of-custody record. Standard export SLA and one-time export fee apply for large pulls.

DocuSign: procurement asked for the DPA amendment link — I've attached a DocuSign placeholder (dpa_amendment_docusign_link.txt) for your legal team to review and sign.

Attachments delivered with this message: sample_admin_events_20270422.jsonl (attached as reference), export_sample_manifest.jsonl, redwood_admin_activity_schema.csv, s3_presigned_link.txt, dpa_amendment_docusign_link.txt

If you want, we can do a short call (15 min) to walk your auditors through the manifest fields next week.

Best,
Tessa Morgan
Enterprise Security Liaison | Redwood Inference

Samir
